events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury, 35 years after we lost him. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative as it did back in '65.

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since The Beatles legend John Lennon was tragically killed in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, a visionary artist and peace advocate, 46 years after his passing. His legacy endures.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating David Bowie
angles.copy: Celebrating the life and extraordinary artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: The King lives on! Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today, and his unparalleled impact on music.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! Still inspiring guitarists everywhere with his incredible riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: From rock anthems to timeless ballads, wishing Rod Stewart a very happy 82nd birthday!

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)", celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got those smooth vocals that defined the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly Parton
angles.copy: Wishing the one and only Dolly Parton a very happy 81st birthday! A true superstar and a national treasure.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the incredible Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo career, a true pop legend.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British soul singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like "Caribbean Queen", celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Get out your dancing shoes! Wishing the fantastic Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Ceremony
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring pioneers like Chuck Berry and The Beatles.

angles.name: Rock Hall of Fame Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock history was made with the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who are your ultimate rock legends?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! Still bringing the magic with Take That.

events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic final live performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67

angles.name: Happy Birthday Hugh Grant

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash in 1959, an event known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: Day The Music Died Anniversary
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, 68 years after "The Day The Music Died." Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82

angles.name: Celebrating Bob Marley

events.title: Carole King turns 85

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 Years On

angles.name: Remembering Whitney Houston
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled voice and talent of Whitney Houston, 15 years after we lost her. Her music continues to soar.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary: 32 Years On
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That famously announced their split, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: Take That Split
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, the pop world stood still as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they're back and stronger than ever!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
